title: Configure the Google Drive rclone remote
context: Add a Google Drive remote and upload the encrypted archive to a dedicated folder.

spec.summary: Configure the Google Drive rclone remote
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: rclone remote `gdrive` is configured with least-privilege scope.
The destination is a private `gitea-backup` folder.
Tokens are mode 600 and outside the repository.
The runbook records the remote name and folder.
